title: Polygenic Risk Scores for Cardiovascular Disease: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Polygenic Risk Scores for Cardiovascular Disease: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Cardiovascular disease is the leading contributor to years lost due to disability or premature death among adults.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Polygenic Risk Scores for Cardiovascular Disease: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】Genetic profiling is becoming widespread in large-scale research, including in health care-associated biobanks, randomized controlled trials, and direct-to-consumer profiling in tens of millions of people.

【Abstract · abstract-1-13】We selected 5 cardiometabolic diseases (coronary artery disease, hypercholesterolemia, type 2 diabetes, atrial fibrillation, and venous thromboembolic disease) and response to drug therapy and offer provisional guidance to health care professionals, researchers, policymakers, and patients.

evidence.text: Genetic profiling is becoming widespread in large-scale research, including in health care-associated biobanks, randomized controlled trials, and direct-to-consumer profiling in tens of millions of people.

We selected 5 cardiometabolic diseases (coronary artery disease, hypercholesterolemia, type 2 diabetes, atrial fibrillation, and venous thromboembolic disease) and response to drug therapy and offer provisional guidance to health care professionals, researchers, policymakers, and patients.
